**`products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`** — the source of truth:
- Route key `/ml-inference/decisions` → `/ml-inference/playground`, still mapping to the same `DecisionPlayground` scene.
- `urls.decisionPlayground()` now returns the new path.

**`frontend/src/products.tsx`** — the generated aggregate of all product manifests, with the same two lines updated.

Everything in the app that navigates to the playground goes through `urls.decisionPlayground()`, so no call sites needed editing. I checked: the only consumer is the Storybook story (`DecisionPlayground.stories.tsx`, `pageUrl: urls.decisionPlayground()`), which follows automatically. There is no sidebar or tree entry for this scene — the manifest's `treeItemsProducts` is empty and the page is reached by URL behind the `ml-inference-decisions` flag.

## What I deliberately left alone

- The backend API path `api/projects/:team_id/ml_inference/decisions/decide/` and the generated client in `products/ml_inference/frontend/generated/` — that's the decision endpoint, not the page address.
- The feature flag key `ml-inference-decisions` (`frontend/src/lib/constants.tsx:412`) — flag keys are a frozen contract, and the backend checks the same string.
- Scene name, breadcrumbs and content, per your ask that only the serving location move.

## Notes

`frontend/src/products.tsx` is normally produced by `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend build:products`. `node_modules` isn't installed here and you asked me not to install, so I applied the two lines by hand. I read the generator to confirm the result is identical to a regeneration: routes are emitted in manifest-file order with no per-key sorting, ml_inference contributes one route, and the new key sorts between `/metrics` and `/notebooks/...` exactly where the old one sat. Running `build:products` will produce a no-op diff.

I did not add a test. Asserting `urls.decisionPlayground() === '/ml-inference/playground'` would only restate the constant, and manifest-to-generated drift is already caught by the `build:products` CI gate.

One thing worth your call: this is a hard move, so an existing bookmark to `/ml-inference/decisions` will now 404.
